Multiprogressbar.summary: Multi-segment progress bar: draws color/texture segments from the bars list. Inherits from Control.

props.padding: Content padding {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels
props.fillPadding: Extra inset of the fill area from the control edges {left, top, right, bottom}
props.drawBorder: Whether to stroke a border along the fill area with borderColor; default false
props.borderColor: Border color, used only when drawBorder is true; default {1,0,0,1}
props.reverse: When true, draws from the far end; default false
props.scaleFunction: Optional mapping function: receives the 0-1 total fraction and returns a 0-1 drawing fraction, used to compress segments non-linearly
props.bars: Segment list; each {color1,color2,percent,texture,s,t,tileSize}: color1 to color2 gradient, percent share of the length, texture path, s/t texture coordinates and tileSize for tiling

Multiprogressbar:DrawControl.desc: Draws each segment as a gradient quad plus optional texture and adds the outer border when needed; scaleFunction first rescales the segment shares.

Multiprogressbar:HitTest.desc: Always returns self, so the whole control is a hit.

fileDesc: Multi-segment progress bar control: draws color/texture segments from the bars list, horizontally or vertically and optionally reversed.
